g.text: Hour-16 SCAI proxy by early SpO₂ instability

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52606d

g.text: Descriptive, unadjusted comparison within each sample; no inference of causation or predictive performance.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #263542

g.text: Stage A cannot be determined from the available data; it is not a zero-prevalence category.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52606d

g.text: B–E are minimum evidenced SCAI proxy stages. Unclassified stays may include stage A or higher stages.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52606d

g.text: Percentages use each exposure group's full sample; labels show count (percentage). Counts are ICU stays; the model samples overlap and are subsets of the full cohort.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52606d

g.text: Physiology: latest valid value in hours 12–16; treatment evidence at hour 16. ICU departure/discharge categories combined for display.
